protocol.schedule: Alternate arm order per pair; restore identical scratch baseline before each arm. Cold means fresh application process, not flushed OS caches. Warmups2 and samples5 retained. stopRules: Any failed/cancelled/missing process rejects the cohort; retain it without retry or replacement.
Any accepted stale source, false task pass, unknown recording failure or integrity mismatch rejects correctness.
No threshold changes after observing the cohort; any repair is a new candidate and retains this report.
